MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 19
   C. 8
   D. 11

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 25

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 1

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
